note: girihelix does not use GSD phases. Planning artefacts live in docs/superpowers/{specs,plans}/ plus docs/backlog.md. The phase/plan/task fields are null because there is no phase to pause in; .planning/.continue-here.md carries the real state.

human_actions_pending.action: Decide what to do with the now-tracked .planning/ directory
human_actions_pending.context: .planning/ is not gitignored in this repo. This handoff commit makes it tracked. The project's planning has lived in docs/superpowers/ until now, so either gitignore .planning/ or accept it as a second home.

decisions.decision: Engine algorithms are authored as labelled sequences of pure steps, run by one interpreter retaining every frame
decisions.rationale: Backward stepping, scrubbing and URL-shareable frames fall out of immutability; the engine stays pure functions. Measured: a broadcast cannot pause a pure function, so PubSub cannot be the stepping mechanism.

decisions.decision: Three tiers for refusing malformed values: @opaque plus a fallible constructor for structural invariants; a sharpened @spec so the compiler rejects the call; a result tuple for numeric properties
decisions.rationale: Chosen by what kind of guarantee is available. Measured: the compiler checks call sites against specs and is silent on opacity; dialyzer checks bodies and reports call_without_opaque on external construction.

decisions.decision: Dialyzer added to the precommit alias
decisions.rationale: It is load-bearing for tier 1, since @opaque is invisible to the compiler. Measured clean (0 errors) and cheap when warm: 57s cold PLT, ~3s warm.

decisions.decision: A Segment type as the primary vehicle, collapsing five error cases into one constructor
decisions.rationale: Point.parameterization_on_line/3, Transform.reflect_through_line/2 and match_two_segments/4, and the degenerate reasons in Intersect, all fail because two points the caller believed were distinct were not. Distinctness makes three of them total; match_two_segments is provably invertible because its determinant is the squared segment length.

decisions.decision: Map will be renamed PlanarMap, with mergeSimpleMany to replicate/2 and mergeMap to weld/2
decisions.rationale: Map is a built-in Elixir module, so our module cannot refer to itself by that name and a caller aliasing it shadows Map.new/2. Nothing is in code yet, so it is a naming decision with no migration cost; to be settled in Plan 1b's plan.

decisions.decision: Exact arithmetic is a recorded post-v1 intention, not a v1 task
decisions.rationale: The tolerances are behavioural specification, not numerical hygiene, so exact arithmetic would produce different geometry from Taprats and leave nothing to verify against; and the coordinates are irrational for essentially every n, so exact rationals cannot hold them.
